Yes, it still feels giftable, but it does not come in a traditional gift box with tissue. It arrives in our standard mailer. For US orders from spanx.com:

Standard: 5-9 business days
Basic: 3-4 business days
Expedited: 1-2 business days
Overnight: 1 business day

Orders also include 1 business day for processing. If you want, I can help you pick the safest option for your date. ✨
